Threads is whe...
fullDesc:
Say more with Threads — Instagram’s text-based conversation app.

Threads is where communities come together to discuss everything from the topics you care about today to what’ll be trending tomorrow. Whatever it is you’re interested in, you can follow and connect directly with your favorite creators and others who love the same things — or build a loyal following of your own to share your ideas, opinions and creativity with the world!

A few things you can do on Threads…

■ Access your Instagram followers
Your Instagram username and verification badge are reserved for you. Automatically follow the same accounts you follow on Instagram in a few taps, and discover new accounts too.

■ Share your point of view
Spin up a new thread to express what's on your mind. This is your space to be yourself, and you control who can reply.

■ Connect with friends and your favorite creators
Jump to the replies to get in on the action and react to commentary, humor and insight from the creators you know and love. Find your community and connect with people who care about whatever it is you’re interested in.

■ Control the conversation
Customize your settings and use controls to manage who can see your content, reply to your threads, or mention you. Accounts you’ve blocked will carry over from Instagram, and we’re enforcing the same Community Guidelines to help ensure everyone interacts safely and authentically. 

■ Find ideas and inspiration
From TV recommendations to career advice, get answers to your questions or learn something new from crowd-sourced conversations, thought leaders and industry experts.

■ Never miss a moment
Stay on top of the latest trends and live events. Whether it’s about new music, movie premieres, sports, games, TV shows, fashion, or the latest product releases, find discussions and receive notifications any time your favorite profiles start a new thread.

■ Leap into the fediverse
Threads is part of the fediverse, a global, open, social network of independent servers operated by third parties around the world. Servers share information with each other to enable people to connect and discover new things across the fediverse.

Welcome to your new summer job at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, where kids and parents alike come for entertainment and food as far as the eye can see! The main attraction is Freddy Fazbear, of course; and his two friends. They are animatronic robots, programmed to please the crowds! The robots' behavior has become somewhat unpredictable at night however, and it was much cheaper to hire you as a security guard than to find a repairman.

From your small office you must watch the security cameras carefully. You have a very limited amount of electricity that you're allowed to use per night (corporate budget cuts, you know). Can you survive five nights at Freddy's?

name: Block Blast
title: Block Blast
desc: Giấy xác nhận thông báo cung cấp dịch vụ trò chơi điện tử trên mạng số 49/GXN-PT...
fullDesc:
Giấy xác nhận thông báo cung cấp dịch vụ trò chơi điện tử trên mạng số 49/GXN-PTTH&TTĐT do Cục phát thanh truyền hình và thông tin điện tử cấp ngày 13/03/2024

Bước vào thế giới của Block Blast – nơi mỗi bước đi đều thử thách sự khéo léo và chiến lược của bạn, mang lại cảm giác bùng nổ cực kỳ thỏa mãn. Dù bạn muốn thư giãn hay rèn luyện trí tuệ, đây là trò chơi xếp hình cực cuốn, dễ chơi mà khó dứt ra. Trò chơi lý tưởng để giải trí bất cứ lúc nào, kể cả khi không cần mạng. Nếu bạn yêu thích trò chơi xếp gạch và ghép hình, đừng bỏ lỡ nhé!

 Vì sao bạn sẽ thích trò chơi Block Blast:
• Cuộc phiêu lưu xếp hình đầy màu sắc: Kéo thả các khối màu lên lưới 8x8, hoàn thành hàng hoặc cột và xem chúng nổ tung rực rỡ. Một trò chơi xếp gạch và ghép hình tuyệt vời để giải trí!
• Combo và chuỗi liên tiếp: Xóa nhiều hàng trong một lượt để tạo combo mạnh mẽ. Giữ chuỗi lâu dài để đạt điểm số siêu cao trong trò chơi xếp hình không cần mạng.
• Vừa thư giãn vừa thử thách: Chơi theo cách của bạn – thư giãn nhẹ nhàng hay tập trung chiến lược để phá kỷ lục. Một trò chơi giải trí phù hợp cho mọi người.
• Chơi không cần mạng mọi lúc mọi nơi: Không có Wi-Fi? Không sao! Thoải mái chơi bất cứ khi nào với những trò chơi xếp hình và xếp gạch hấp dẫn.

Những điểm nổi bật của trò chơi Block Blast:
• Hệ thống combo & chuỗi: Càng xóa nhiều, điểm càng cao — thỏa mãn đam mê chinh phục và chơi mọi lúc, không cần mạng!
• Chế độ phiêu lưu: Càng lên cao càng thử thách, mỗi cấp độ đều có giao diện và chủ đề riêng.
• Thử thách mỗi tuần: Cập nhật trò chơi xếp hình mới hàng tuần và nhận phần thưởng đặc biệt.
• Tối ưu cho mọi thiết bị: Trò chơi mượt mà, nhẹ nhàng, chơi ngon lành trên cả điện thoại và máy tính bảng.

Cách chơi:
• Kéo & thả: Đặt các khối vào lưới 8x8 một cách hợp lý.
• Xóa và ghi điểm: Hoàn thành hàng hoặc cột để nổ và nhận điểm.
• Lên kế hoạch combo: Tính toán để tạo combo lớn và nhận thêm điểm thưởng.
• Luôn để trống chỗ: Đừng để lưới bị đầy, giữ không gian cho các khối lớn hơn.

Mẹo hay để chơi giỏi:
• Nghĩ trước vài bước: Giúp bạn giữ lưới luôn thoáng cho các khối lớn.
• Tập trung tạo combo: Xóa nhiều hàng một lúc để tăng điểm nhanh.
• Duy trì chuỗi: Càng xóa liên tục, phần thưởng trong trò chơi càng lớn.

Tải ngay trò chơi Block Blast và chơi thôi!
Sẵn sàng thử thách trí tuệ, giải trí thả ga và chinh phục những màn xếp hình cực đã chưa? Tải ngay Block Blast và bước vào hành trình xếp gạch và ghép hình hấp dẫn. Dù ở nhà, trên xe hay lúc rảnh rỗi, chỉ cần mở trò chơi là có thể chơi ngay, không cần mạng!

title: Pocket
desc: Locket is a widget that shows live photos from your best friends, right to your ...
fullDesc:
Locket is a widget that shows live photos from your best friends, right to your Home Screen. You and your best friends will see new pictures from each other every time you unlock your phone. It’s a little glimpse of what everyone’s up to throughout the day.
 
HOW IT WORKS
1. Add the Locket widget to your Home Screen
2. When a friend sends you a photo, it instantly appears on your Locket widget!
3. To share a pic back, tap into the widget, take a pic with the camera, and then hit send! It appears right on your friends’ Home Screens
 
FOR YOUR CLOSE FRIENDS
• To keep things friendly, you can only have 20 friends on the app.
• On Locket, there’s no worrying about follower count, just add your best friends and family and live in the moment.
• With Locket, you’re able to be real and share photos to the people that matter.
 
REACT TO FRIENDS' PHOTOS
• Send a Locket reaction to your friends to let them know you saw their image.
• They’ll get a notification and you’ll love watching the emojis rain down on your photo.
• We don’t count or track the reactions, so you can be real and authentic without worrying about likes and filters like other platforms.
 
BUILD A HISTORY OF YOUR LOCKETS
• As you and friends snap Lockets, you’ll build up a history of all images sent.
• Share them out as photos or use our video recap feature to stitch together the memories of you and your friends, capturing those “love it” moments.
• Locket will also make you a recap video at the end of every month with all of the photos you've shared.
 
ADD LOCKETS FOR YOUR BESTIES AND CRUSHES
• Decorate your home screen with more photos and images dedicated to your crush or your bestie
• Add the “Crush” or “Best Friend” picture widget, and see photos only from that person. Plus, you can send images just to that person too!
 
Here’s what our users say:
 
“I love this app because I get to share cute pictures to my friends” - HI
“AMAZING SO WORTH IT” - rikkibear29282902
“Best app made this year” - johanjodel_
 
Plus, users love our camera (so you’ll love the photos!) - @sonnielove3 on Twitter even said, “It’s sum about that locket camera”
 
Download the free app! We’re keeping Locket free so you can send photos to the people that matter (friends, family, bestie, etc.). With Locket, your phone will feel like it’s bringing you closer to your best friends.
 
Please write to us at team@locketcamera.com. Thanks for having Locket on your Home Screen!

Challenge frie...
fullDesc:
Play MONOPOLY on the go without distractions – no ads, no fuss! 

Challenge friends, family and fans from around the globe in the digital version of the official MONOPOLY board game, licensed by Hasbro. 

Head online to play your favourite board game with anyone, anywhere, at any time, or compete against state-of-the-art AI opponents offline. Plus, with the seamless PASS & PLAY mode, you can play the classic MONOPOLY board game with your friends with just one device! 

The classic MONOPOLY board game takes a bold leap into a new format, arriving on mobile with amazing graphics, smooth animations and a catchy soundtrack! 


HOW TO PLAY MONOPOLY

1. Download the official MONOPOLY app
2. Press “PLAY”
3. Pick a mode, board, dice and token
4. Roll the dice and move around the board
5. If you land on a property tile, you can buy it
6. Collect rent when other players land on it
7. Continue around the board, drawing cards when instructed – will you be hit with a surprise tax? Sent to jail? Or get a little bonus money? 
8. If you run out of money, you’ll be bankrupt and out of the game
9. The last player left with a profit wins! 

FEATURES

- MONOPOLY ON THE GO – No connection? No problem. Our roster of AI opponents are ready to challenge you! Or play with your friends offline with Pass & Play! 
- MULTIPLE MODES – Take on AI opponents in Single Player or compete against friends and family in Pass & Play or Online With Friends. Try out Online Multiplayer and face off against fellow tycoons from around the world! 
- EXCLUSIVE BOARDS – Experience the iconic board game like never before with exclusive boards and more! 
- AWESOME NEW TOKENS AND DICE – Whatever your style, MONOPOLY has a set of dice fit for a future tycoon! Pick from nostalgic classic tokens or brand-new designs exclusive to the mobile game.

Get the most authentic MONOPOLY experience with the official MONOPOLY mobile game!

Coming soon:
— More of the features you want in online multiplayer games, such as…
— Large settlements where you can talk to other players.
— Clan bases, to develop and explore aberrated areas with your friends in an online survival mode.
— MMO boss raids and clan zombie hunts.
— Co-op PvE quests.


Story:
Humanity has fallen; the dead have risen. Dark games are afoot. You are a survivor, a stalker, wandering the Wastelands. Your task is to explore these lands, where man is more to be feared than beast, and a can of meat or a pair of worn-out boots is reason enough for murder. Your friend Sherp, an expert on nuclear aberrations, has gone missing in the Last Territories. It's down to you to find out what happened to him and uncover the true cause of the apocalypse. If you're lucky enough to survive in the days after, that is...

Góc tuổi thơ, cửa hàng ký ức
Biển hiệu bằng sắt, kệ hàng bằng gỗ, bảng giá viết tay, kẹo mơ 200, kẹo cao su 300, nước ngọt 500, ngồi xuống chiếc ghế đẩu nhỏ, và Tiệm Tạp Hóa Thời Gian chính thức khai trương rồi!

desc:
OnceWorld is a simple and casual 2D solo-play RPG.
Relive the charm of classic M...
fullDesc:
OnceWorld is a simple and casual 2D solo-play RPG.
Relive the charm of classic MMOs from the good old days — now reimagined for mobile with easy controls and deep progression!
Level up, reincarnate, raise pets, awaken equipment, collect materials, and battle in the arena — all in one nostalgic adventure.

It’s an RPG that brings the essence of those mid-2000s MMORPGs to your smartphone, blending nostalgia with modern convenience.

▼ Stat Distribution

Distribute points into seven basic stats to develop your character.
Points are earned as your hero levels up.
To reset your distribution, you’ll need a special item.

Stat meanings:

VIT – Increases HP

SPD – Attack speed & number of strikes

ATK – Physical attack power

INT – Magic attack power & SP capacity

DEF – Mainly physical defense power

M.DEF – Mainly magical defense power

LUK – Evasion & Physical Critical

▼ Weapons & Armor

Equip one weapon and five armor pieces.
Wearing all five pieces of a matching set grants a set bonus.
Use the heart icon at the top-left to toggle your favorite gear display.

▼ Equipment Enhancement

Use materials obtained during your adventures to enhance your gear.
Each enhancement attempt has a success rate — failure consumes the materials, but the item itself will never break.
Some special items can increase success rates.

▼ Accessories

Accessories grant special effects when equipped.
Defeating enemies while an accessory is equipped will level it up, enhancing its effects over time.

▼ Magic

Spend SP to cast powerful spells.
Magic attacks cannot be evaded and there are no critical hits.

Certain rare materials may further amplify spell power.



▼ Monsters & Pets

By carrying a special material, you’ll gain the ability to capture monsters.
Captured monsters become pets that grow stronger as they fight alongside you.
Some monsters learn skills as they level up.
These skills can activate even without being summoned, as long as the monster is accompanying you.

Pet switching can only be done at the Pet Keeper in your hometown.
Feeding specific materials will raise a pet’s stats.

▼ Monster Encyclopedia

Once defeated, monsters are added to the encyclopedia where their stats can be viewed.
Captured monsters will display a “Caught” mark.

▼ Materials

Materials are divided into three categories:

Normal Materials
　Used for equipment enhancement and trading.

Effect Materials
　Provide passive bonuses simply by owning them.
　Have a smaller carrying limit.

Key Items
　Only one can be held.
　Cannot be dropped or sold.

▼ Items

Items that grant various benefits during adventures.
You can assign them to shortcut slots for quick use in the field.
Swap registered items using the arrow icon beside the item list.

▼ Reincarnation

When your hero reaches the level cap, you can reincarnate.
Reincarnation resets your level but increases your level cap and available stat points, allowing for further growth.

▼ Abyss Corridor

A ranked mode that can be played a limited number of times per day.
Clear each floor by defeating all monsters as fast as possible — faster times rank higher.
Treasure chests appear as rewards on each floor.
Only Save Slot 1 is eligible for ranking participation.

▼ Arena

Watch monster battles.
Watch monster battles held several times a day.
Choose the strongest team from three teams and watch the battle.

Earn Arena Coins if your favorite team wins.
Try exchanging them for valuable materials at the Arena Shop.

▼ About the Kin-Slayer Rite ▼

The Kin-Slayer Rite
is a ceremony in which the target pet’s kin-bond, level,
and accumulated experience are all returned to zero
in exchange for enhancing its base stats.

A monster that undergoes this rite will gain experience
at a slower rate thereafter.

desc: **Happier** is an open-source, end-to-end encrypted companion app for AI coding ...
fullDesc:
**Happier** is an open-source, end-to-end encrypted companion app for AI coding agents. It takes the power of Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, and OpenCode and lets you run sessions on your computer, and continue them from your phone — including collaboration, reliable resume, and full history access.

Whether you’re on a train through the Alps or grabbing a coffee, Happier ensures your AI coding sessions never skip a beat.

**Important**: This app requires the Happier CLI and at least one supported provider (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, OpenCode) installed on your computer. The iOS app acts as a secure bridge between your local development environment and your mobile device.

### Why "Happier"?
Happier started as a fork of **Happy**. We were using Happy daily for work and loved the concept, but we needed faster iteration, stronger reliability, and a set of features that weren’t available yet. After weeks of building and refining, we are sharing it so others can try it and help shape what comes next.

Happier lets you **build** anything you want—with friends. We’ve rebuilt the foundation to support more models, more platforms, and more ways to work together.

### Features:
*  **Collaborative sessions:** share a session with teammates & friends (private or public links).
*  **Broad provider support:** works with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, OpenCode, and more (configurable).
*  **Persistent sessions:** resume sessions even after restarts; archive and return later.
*  **Seamless switching:** move between terminal, web UI, and mobile while keeping context.
*  **Subscriptions or API keys:** use your existing Claude Pro/Codex/Gemini subscriptions, or configure API keys in-app.
*  **Infinite history:** scroll back through older messages in long sessions.
*  **Pending queue:** edit/reorder queued messages before the agent processes them.
*  **tmux support:** resume remote-started sessions locally (Claude).

### Security & privacy
* **End-to-End Encryption**: built using the same encryption as Signal (TweetNaCl)
* **Zero-Knowledge**: your code is encrypted on your machine before it ever hits the wire. We cannot read your data. Your encryption keys never leave your devices.
* **Built in Switzerland:** developed in Switzerland, with a strong focus on data protection and developer transparency.

### How It Works:
1.  Install the `happier-cli` on your Mac, Linux, or PC.
2.  Pair your device instantly with a secure QR code.
3.  Start a session (e.g., `happier claude` or `happier codex`).
4.  Code solo, or invite a friend to jump into the session with you.

### Community-Driven

**Happier** is completely open-source. We built this because we wanted a more powerful, more social way to interact with AI agents - and we want to build it in the open, shaped by the people who actually use it.

This project exists because we needed it ourselves - and we want it to evolve through real feedback. We aim to keep the community welcoming and contributor-friendly, whether you’re signaling an issue or proposing a larger idea.

What that means in practice:
*  **Open development** and transparent discussions
*  **Fast feedback loops** on issues and pull requests
*  A focus on **solving real developer pain**, not chasing hype

If something feels broken, missing, or awkward - we want to hear about it.
Happier grows through shared experience and collaboration.

**Code faster. Code together. Be Happier.**

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic, OpenAI, or Google.

title: Telegram 2
desc: Pure instant messaging — simple, fast, secure, and synced across all your device...
fullDesc:
Pure instant messaging — simple, fast, secure, and synced across all your devices. One of the top 5 most downloaded apps in the world with over 1 billion active users.

FAST: Telegram is the fastest messaging app on the market, connecting people via a unique, distributed network of data centers around the globe.

SYNCED: You can access your messages from all your phones, tablets and computers at once. Telegram apps are standalone, so you don’t need to keep your phone connected. Start typing on one device and finish the message from another. Never lose your data again.

UNLIMITED: You can send media and files, without any limits on their type and size. Your entire chat history will require no disk space on your device, and will be securely stored in the Telegram cloud for as long as you need it. 

SECURE: We made it our mission to provide the best security combined with ease of use. Everything on Telegram, including chats, groups, media, etc. is encrypted using a combination of 256-bit symmetric AES encryption, 2048-bit RSA encryption, and Diffie–Hellman secure key exchange. 

100% FREE & OPEN: Telegram has a fully documented and free API for developers, open source apps and verifiable builds to prove the app you download is built from the exact same source code that is published. 

POWERFUL: You can create group chats with up to 200,000 members, share large videos, documents of any type (.DOCX, .MP3, .ZIP, etc.) up to 2 GB each, and even set up bots for specific tasks. Telegram is the perfect tool for hosting online communities and coordinating teamwork.

RELIABLE: Built to deliver your messages using as little data as possible, Telegram is the most reliable messaging system ever made. It works even on the weakest mobile connections. 

FUN: Telegram has powerful photo and video editing tools, animated stickers and emoji, fully customizable themes to change the appearance of your app, and an open sticker/GIF platform to cater to all your expressive needs.

SIMPLE: While providing an unprecedented array of features, we take great care to keep the interface clean. Telegram is so simple you already know how to use it.

PRIVATE: We take your privacy seriously and will never give any third parties access to your data. You can delete any message you ever sent or received for both sides, at any time and without a trace. Telegram will never use your data to show you ads.

For those interested in maximum privacy, Telegram offers Secret Chats. Secret Chat messages can be programmed to self-destruct automatically from both participating devices. This way you can send all types of disappearing content — messages, photos, videos, and even files. Secret Chats use End-to-End Encryption to ensure that a message can only be read by its intended recipient.

We keep expanding the boundaries of what you can do with a messaging app. Don’t wait years for older messengers to catch up with Telegram — join the revolution today.

desc: Giấy xác nhận thông báo cung cấp dịch vụ trò chơi điện tử trên mạng số 49/GXN-PT...
fullDesc:
Giấy xác nhận thông báo cung cấp dịch vụ trò chơi điện tử trên mạng số 49/GXN-PTTH&TTĐT do Cục phát thanh truyền hình và thông tin điện tử cấp ngày 13/03/2024

Bước vào thế giới của Block Blast – nơi mỗi bước đi đều thử thách sự khéo léo và chiến lược của bạn, mang lại cảm giác bùng nổ cực kỳ thỏa mãn. Dù bạn muốn thư giãn hay rèn luyện trí tuệ, đây là trò chơi xếp hình cực cuốn, dễ chơi mà khó dứt ra. Trò chơi lý tưởng để giải trí bất cứ lúc nào, kể cả khi không cần mạng. Nếu bạn yêu thích trò chơi xếp gạch và ghép hình, đừng bỏ lỡ nhé!

 Vì sao bạn sẽ thích trò chơi Block Blast:
• Cuộc phiêu lưu xếp hình đầy màu sắc: Kéo thả các khối màu lên lưới 8x8, hoàn thành hàng hoặc cột và xem chúng nổ tung rực rỡ. Một trò chơi xếp gạch và ghép hình tuyệt vời để giải trí!
• Combo và chuỗi liên tiếp: Xóa nhiều hàng trong một lượt để tạo combo mạnh mẽ. Giữ chuỗi lâu dài để đạt điểm số siêu cao trong trò chơi xếp hình không cần mạng.
• Vừa thư giãn vừa thử thách: Chơi theo cách của bạn – thư giãn nhẹ nhàng hay tập trung chiến lược để phá kỷ lục. Một trò chơi giải trí phù hợp cho mọi người.
• Chơi không cần mạng mọi lúc mọi nơi: Không có Wi-Fi? Không sao! Thoải mái chơi bất cứ khi nào với những trò chơi xếp hình và xếp gạch hấp dẫn.

Những điểm nổi bật của trò chơi Block Blast:
• Hệ thống combo & chuỗi: Càng xóa nhiều, điểm càng cao — thỏa mãn đam mê chinh phục và chơi mọi lúc, không cần mạng!
• Chế độ phiêu lưu: Càng lên cao càng thử thách, mỗi cấp độ đều có giao diện và chủ đề riêng.
• Thử thách mỗi tuần: Cập nhật trò chơi xếp hình mới hàng tuần và nhận phần thưởng đặc biệt.
• Tối ưu cho mọi thiết bị: Trò chơi mượt mà, nhẹ nhàng, chơi ngon lành trên cả điện thoại và máy tính bảng.

Cách chơi:
• Kéo & thả: Đặt các khối vào lưới 8x8 một cách hợp lý.
• Xóa và ghi điểm: Hoàn thành hàng hoặc cột để nổ và nhận điểm.
• Lên kế hoạch combo: Tính toán để tạo combo lớn và nhận thêm điểm thưởng.
• Luôn để trống chỗ: Đừng để lưới bị đầy, giữ không gian cho các khối lớn hơn.

Mẹo hay để chơi giỏi:
• Nghĩ trước vài bước: Giúp bạn giữ lưới luôn thoáng cho các khối lớn.
• Tập trung tạo combo: Xóa nhiều hàng một lúc để tăng điểm nhanh.
• Duy trì chuỗi: Càng xóa liên tục, phần thưởng trong trò chơi càng lớn.

Tải ngay trò chơi Block Blast và chơi thôi!
Sẵn sàng thử thách trí tuệ, giải trí thả ga và chinh phục những màn xếp hình cực đã chưa? Tải ngay Block Blast và bước vào hành trình xếp gạch và ghép hình hấp dẫn. Dù ở nhà, trên xe hay lúc rảnh rỗi, chỉ cần mở trò chơi là có thể chơi ngay, không cần mạng!
